byteward.sentence: Lumora on Thursday announced the Arc 7, its new flagship phone.
At its center is the Facet 3, the latest chip Lumora designs in-house.
On the back, the main camera uses a 50-megapixel sensor.
Powering it all is a 5,000 mAh battery.

launch-desk.sentence: Lumora has launched the Arc 7, its latest flagship phone.
The phone will be sold in 14 countries at launch.
Inside is the Facet 3, Lumora's newest in-house chip.

frametime.sentence: Lumora announced the Arc 7 today, its new flagship phone.
Driving it is the Facet 3, Lumora's newest in-house chip.
In our multi-core CPU test, the Arc 7 finished 24% ahead of the Arc 6.
In Pinefall Arena at maximum settings, it averaged 58 frames per second.
Sustained load is another story: after 20 minutes of our stress test, the phone was holding just 71% of its peak speed.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: The Arc 7 is built around the Facet 3, Lumora's newest in-house chip.
Lumora has it made on a 2 nm process.
To spread that heat, the phone uses a vapor chamber 30 percent larger than the Arc 6's.
It helps, up to a point: in our 20-minute stress test, the Arc 7 settled at 71 percent of its peak performance.
The battery is a 5,000 mAh cell.

bench-and-bill.sentence: Lumora announced the Arc 7 on Thursday, the newest phone in its flagship line.
The same day, it filed a repair plan for the phone under the Parts and Manuals Act.
In the filing, Lumora commits to selling spare parts for the Arc 7 for seven years.
Repair manuals will be free to download from the day the phone goes on sale.
The plan also says the battery can be removed with a standard screwdriver.
